title: AIOS Runs Index Schema
description: Schema for the root status.json WHEN the engine is in multi-run mode (parallelism Fase A). In this mode the root status.json is a LIGHTWEIGHT INDEX of active runs, not the full state. The full per-run state (13 legacy fields, schema aios-status-v1) lives in runs/{runId}/status.json and is validated by status.schema.json. Backward compatibility: if runs/ does not exist, status.json keeps the legacy aios-status-v1 shape and status.schema.json applies instead. The aios-validate hook (handoff_engine.py _validate_status_basic) accepts BOTH schema strings on the root file.

schema.description: Schema version identifier for the multi-run index

activeRuns.description: List of currently active runs. Each entry is a run descriptor.

startedAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp the run was registered

lastUpdate.description: ISO8601 timestamp of the last index update
